seo.description: Eighteen lifts and 67 runs over 835 height metres at Øyer, the mountain that held the alpine events of the 1994 Lillehammer Olympics.

seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Hafjell at Øyer in Innlandet, Norway.

h1: Hafjell ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Hafjell rises above Øyer with 18 lifts and 67 runs over 835 height metres, fifteen kilometres up the valley from Lillehammer. The mountain held the alpine events of the 1994 Winter Olympics and has been a Norwegian World Cup venue since.
stayOverview: Hafjell is a lift base rather than a village. The beds at the foot of the slopes are the ski-in ones; Lillehammer, fifteen kilometres away, has the rest and the restaurants.
hotelIntro: Decide between the slope and the town: Hafjell base for the first lift, Lillehammer for somewhere to eat afterwards.
rentalCars: A car is useful. Hafjell is fifteen kilometres from Lillehammer, which is on the Oslo-Trondheim railway.
